intended_object: The inclusion map U_{r+1}(R) ↪ U_r(R) between successive stages of the filtration of the unitriangular group by superdiagonal subgroups (matrices that agree with the identity on the first r superdiagonals). Inferred from the docstring "successor inclusion" and how it is used in the file.
explanation:
The body sends an element s of `superdiagonalSubgroup n R (r+1)` to the same underlying matrix `s.1`, now seen as an element of `superdiagonalSubgroup n R r`. The membership proof is the containment lemma `superdiagonalSubgroup_succ_le`. So this is exactly the set-theoretic inclusion of the (r+1)-th stage of the filtration into the r-th stage, which is what the docstring says.

It is a specific map, so it is not too narrow. As a function it agrees with Mathlib's general `Subgroup.inclusion` applied to `superdiagonalSubgroup_succ_le`, except that it is not bundled as a homomorphism. The file uses it in compatibility lemmas with the stage group schemes. Nothing is wrong with it.
